title: Fire in the hole....be warned
text:
Fire in the hole....be warned. Bought this as an add-on with new toaster oven. Carefully placed it on crumb tray (ZERO instructions included). Darn thing caught fire the very first time I tried to make toast. Flames, smoke...scorched crumb tray on an hours old toaster oven. I can't believe this product is also recommended for BBQ grill...just not gonna withstand that type of heat

Insult to injury, Amazon wants me to drop this off to return it....frankly I think Amazon should consider the reviews and have it removed as a safety hazard.
